giver.description: The giver's DID, or empty when they weren't signed in.

plant.description: The plant's id in the game's plants.json.

giverName.description: The giver's name when they gave it.

gift.description: A Gift in a garden: the plant, and who gave it when.

copy.description: The garden copy: the whole garden, gzipped JSON.

guid.description: The save's guid, so the owner's game knows which of its gardens this is.

name.description: The garden's name, as its owner typed it.

biome.description: The biome's id in the game's biomes.json.

gifts.description: The Gifts in the garden, which every visitor gets.

rules.description: Who may plant, when shared. Missing means only the owner.

shared.description: Friends may garden here, under rules. Otherwise it's for visiting only.

location.description: The real-world location's id within that biome.

plantCount.description: How many plants it has, for lists of gardens.

copyVersion.description: The copy file's version. A game that doesn't know it shows the garden as too new.

gameVersion.description: The version of the game that wrote it.

main.description: Keyed by the save's guid, lower case. The official account keys event gardens by their event's id.

allow.description: Allow rules ticked. The owner may always plant; an empty list means only them.

labels.description: For 'labelled': the moderation labels that keep an account out.

followersOf.description: For 'followersOf': the accounts whose followers may plant.

minAccountDays.description: For 'newAccounts': accounts younger than this many days are kept out.

plantRules.description: Who may plant in a shared garden. Anyone matching an allow rule may plant unless a keep-out rule matches them; blocked accounts are always kept out. An unknown allow rule is ignored; an unknown keep-out rule keeps everyone out.

description: A Sylvanus garden on someone's account. The garden itself is the copy file it points to; this record stays small, for lists of gardens and visits.
